datasets.nstdb: PhysioNet MIT-BIH Noise Stress Test Database 1.0.0 (ODC-By 1.0)

rule: Adopt a candidate over the current model only if, on VALIDATION data: PTB-XL macro-AUC (all statements) drops by at most 0.005, and Ningbo-validation macro-AUC on the mapped statements improves (both models scored with the same, current label map).
history: v0.2 was adopted over v0.1 by this rule with the v0.2 label map; its external-test PVC drop led to finding the label-map error fixed in v0.3.
